settings.question: How does The Muzzle Sleep Club work?
settings.answer: The Muzzle Sleep Club rewards you for shopping, engaging, and building a consistent sleep routine with us. Earn points when you place orders, create an account, leave reviews, follow us on Instagram, add your birthday, and more.

settings.question: Who can join?
settings.answer: Everyone is welcome to join. Create a Muzzle Sleep account to start earning points, track your balance, redeem rewards, and unlock exclusive member perks.

settings.question: How do I earn points?
settings.answer: Earn points by shopping with Muzzle Sleep and completing select rewards activities: creating an account, following us on Instagram, leaving a product review, and adding your birthday.

settings.question: How do I redeem my points?
settings.answer: Log in to your account and open the rewards panel. Select "Ways to Redeem," choose the reward you want, and apply it toward your order at checkout.

settings.question: Do my points apply to subscriptions?
settings.answer: Points may be earned and redeemed according to the active rewards program rules shown in your account. Log in to check available rewards before checkout.

settings.question: Can I use more than one reward at a time?
settings.answer: Reward use may vary depending on the offer, discount, or promotion. Check the details in your rewards account before completing your order.

settings.question: When will my points appear?
settings.answer: Points are typically added after eligible actions are completed. Purchase points may appear after your order is confirmed or fulfilled, depending on program settings.

settings.question: What happens when I reach a new VIP tier?
settings.answer: Once you reach a new tier, you'll automatically unlock that tier's perks and benefits. The more points you earn, the more exclusive rewards you can enjoy — all the way to Sleep VIP.
